title: The critical Schatten exponent for the Berger-Coburn endpoint problem
summary: Berger and Coburn showed that boundedness of a Toeplitz operator $T_g$ on the Fock space controls the heat transform $g^{(t)}$ for $1/4 1$, no corresponding $S_p$ estimate is possible, even for compactly supported smooth symbols. Moreover, a Baire category argument shows there is an admissible symbol $g$ with $T_g\in S_p$ for every $p>1$ while $g^{(1/4)}$ is unbounded, though it yields no explicit symbol. We also determine the optimal constants in the Berger--Coburn estimates for $1/4<t\leq1$.
